title: Neon Undercity: City Stewardship

foundation.history: A forgotten hidden radio library once protected community capacitors, until recurring grid brownouts forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Rika Sen, a planner, must repair shared urban infrastructure, relying on district budgeting despite grid brownouts.
central_conflict: an exclusionary syndicate threatens the hidden radio library by restricting community capacitors.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: grid brownouts destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: an exclusionary syndicate contests access to community capacitors
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The hidden radio library becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
